metadata.query: How is Hydraulic Horsepower (HHP) calculated for an ESP?
metadata.raw_backend_note: This is the exact JSON payload returned by the LangGraph Supervisor before Streamlit HTML cards rendering.

backend_advisory_payload.assessment:
Hydraulic Horsepower (HHP) for an ESP is calculated using the formula:

\[ \text{HHP} = \frac{\text{Flow Rate (Q)} \times \text{Head (H)}}{\text{Specific Gravity (SG)}} \]

Where:
- \( Q \) is the flow rate of the liquid in gallons per minute (gpm).
- \( H \) is the head of the liquid in feet.
- \( SG \) is the specific gravity of the liquid being pumped.

The specific gravity is the ratio of the density of the liquid being pumped to the density of water (approximately 1 for fresh water and 1.06 for salt water). This calculation helps in determining the amount of power required to move the liquid through the ESP pump.
